name: A2 as-built level 2, Designs Unlimited issue 7.2.26, 5008 Velda Dairy Rd
purpose: Ground truth for the plan import acceptance test. Measured on 2026-10-13 from the PDF with PyMuPDF (vector text and lines) and Pillow (raster scans). Values are what a correct extractor must reproduce.

source_pdf.project_copy: attach 2nd_floor.pdf (A2 only) to the build chat; the builder copies it to scripts/fixtures/A2-asbuilt-level2.pdf in the repo

how_the_pdf_is_built.plan_drawing: TWO embedded JPEGs, each painted through a luminosity soft mask built from a FlateDecode grayscale image (xref 15/16 for the logo, xref 20/21 for the plan, so pdfimages lists six image objects): xref 40 is the 800 x 800 firm logo in the title block; xref 42 is the plan, 5063 x 5760 px (783 KB), placed at page rect [588.147, 93.228, 1803.492, 1475.628] pt, which is 300 ppi (the JFIF header says 72:72 with no units; derive ppi from the placement rect, never from the header). Walls are hollow double lines (two 1 px faces with a white core), door swings are arcs, windows are 2 extra lines inside the wall core, fixtures and closet shelving are line work. No text and no color in the raster. The raw JPEG stream holds the full-contrast linework (luma < 170 on 0.94 percent of pixels); a page render through the soft mask is lighter in places, so a render fallback must threshold with Otsu, not a fixed value.
how_the_pdf_is_built.annotations: Vector: 909 line items (dimension lines, extension lines, 45-degree tick marks), 23 curves (scale symbol only), 147 text spans: 124 in the Georgia family (dimension strings, room labels, legend, sheet number) and 23 in Helvetica, Arial and Verdana (title block). Dimension text is rotated 90 degrees for vertical dimensions (dir [0,-1]).

scale.meaning: 1/4 in on paper = 1 ft-0 in real

how_the_pdf_is_built.also_on_sheet: Legend tints are VECTOR filled rectangles with transparency drawn over the plan, not raster pixels. Legend swatch next to TO BE DEMOLISHED: blue-grey rgb(0.48,0.59,0.66) alpha 0.25; in the plan the demolish fills are rgb(0.09,0.34,0.43) or rgb(0.09,0.37,0.48) at alpha 0.15 (18 rectangles: primary bath fixtures and tub deck, laundry fixtures, jack and jill fixtures, closet by guest bath 1). Legend swatch next to DIMENSIONS NEED CONFIRMING: pink rgb(0.92,0.61,0.81) alpha 0.08; in the plan 4 pink rectangles cover guest bathroom 3 with the jack and jill shower, the bottom of guest bedroom 2, and a strip over the W.I.C. and laundry wall. Read fill color and alpha from the operator list; match by hue to the legend swatch nearest each legend text. Rooms whose label falls inside a confirm tint get needs_confirming; items inside a demolish tint are marked to be demolished.

frame.name: sheet-raster-inches
frame.origin: top-left pixel of the plan raster
frame.relation_to_velda_studio_v0_3_frame: v0.3 level 2 coordinates = this frame minus (3.1, 126). Within about 1.5 in; the v0.3 walls were traced by hand-checked scripts. The v0.3 repo reports version 0.2.0 in package.json; the spike notes call the same code v0.3.

dimension_strings.pairing_rule: the parallel vector line nearest the text (within 20 pt) that spans the text center and whose length is closest to inches * 1.5 pt; among lines of equal length, the one nearest the text center wins (4'-8 1/4" and 5'-2" each have an equal-length parallel line a few pt away). Classify orientation with a tolerance: the 2'-8" at the guest bedroom 2 door is rotated about 0.8 degrees. 93 of 98 pair within 1 in; the 5 unpaired are the two diagonal strings across the primary bath shower (4'-10 3/4" and 2'-0") and three short strings drawn beside their lines (2'-8" at the guest bedroom 2 door, 1'-3" by guest bath 1, 1'-0" by the shower).

wall_thickness_checks.where: primary bedroom left exterior wall at y=240 in
primary bedroom top exterior wall at x=448 in
primary bedroom right wall at y=240 in (window band)

openings_expected_on_level.note: counted from reference_walls_v0_3 after the 2026-10-18 corrections (the v0.3 pass had 14 doors and 2 cased openings; strings on the sheet add two doors and two cased openings, and the 79 in sliding door is an open passage on the drawing). A correct import may differ by one or two and must then show the difference in the Confirm step rather than silently drop it

walls_expected.counted_as: wall segments between tees, the same rule on both sides: every wall is split where another wall at least 2 ft long (or exterior) ends on it, never into pieces under 12 in, never inside an opening (splitAtJunctions in src/import/index.ts). The reference after the 2026-10-18 corrections counts the expected number this way; the test computes it rather than trusting a typed number.
walls_expected.note: 59 is the v0.3 list as typed; v0.3 split some walls at junctions and not others (L2w28 to L2w30 split where walls tee in, L2w3 not split where L2w44 and L2w45 tee in), so a raw count only matches an import that happens to split the same way

tint_checks.note: guest bedroom 2 is flagged because the pink rectangle covers its bottom part; the room label itself sits above the tint, so flag a room when a confirm tint overlaps more than 10 percent of its polygon or contains its label

edit_cost.definition: a reference wall matches a produced wall when they are collinear within 1.5 in and overlap at least 80 percent of the shorter one; cost = unmatched reference walls + unmatched produced walls + openings whose kind differs or whose center is more than 2 in off, matched per wall

hard_checks.clear_dimension_checks_rule: each entry is a string on the sheet that spans a clear distance between two wall faces of the named room; after the solve the distance between the faces the string binds to, measured along the string's own line, must equal the string within tol. This also holds for L-shaped rooms.

reference_walls_v0_3.note: hand-checked wall list from Velda Studio v0.3 transformed into this frame (+3.1, +126). Use for topology and openings comparison with 1.5 in position tolerance; the dimension strings above override it where they disagree.
known_gaps: added as L2w60 on 2026-10-18 (was missing: the wall between the Jack and Jill shower and Guest Bathroom 2 at y about 608.4 from x 82.3 to 126.7, with a 2'-4" door, string 90.47 to 118.46 at y 606.47)
positions are the v0.3 trace (within about 1.5 in); where a string disagrees, the string wins
Phase 2 lists every other unmatched wall in the import report rather than assuming the reference is complete

raster_clear_spans_at_labels_note: single-row and single-column scans from each label to the first dark raster pixel. Informational only: several pass through a door or cased opening (primary bedroom depth, guest bedroom 2 and 3 widths, guest bathroom 2 width) or stop at closet shelving or a fixture line (W.I.C., W.I.C, I.T. CLST, guest bathroom 3 at the tub). Re-measured 2026-10-18 within 0.4 in except where the scan line differs.

corrections.what: JPEG header density is 72:72 with no units, not 96 dpi; ppi still comes from the placement rect (299.94 x 300.0).
Each embedded JPEG is drawn through a luminosity soft mask (xref 15/16, 20/21). Raw JPEG decode is the right input; a render fallback is lighter.
Unpaired strings are two diagonals and three short strings, not one diagonal and four short; pairing needs a nearest-line tie-break and an orientation tolerance.

Five clear_dimension_checks named strings that do not lie in that room: GUEST BATHROOM 3 x (6'-8 3/4" is a vertical string by the I.T. closet; no wall-to-wall string spans guest bathroom 3 because 6'-9" stops at the tub), GUEST BATHROOM 2 x (6'-1/4" is in the primary bath; the room's string is 3'-3" = 39), I.T. CLST x (5'-0" is in guest bath 1; 7'-10" runs face to same-side face, so it is not a clear span; dropped), I.T. CLST y (no vertical 3'-9 3/4"; the string is 4'-0" = 48), LAUNDRY ROOM x (10'-4 1/4" is guest bathroom 2's height; the laundry's string is 7'-6 3/4" = 90.75). Added primary bedroom y, guest bedroom 2 x, guest bedroom 3 x and laundry y. Every check now carries the string's line in sheet inches.
147 spans are not all Georgia; the title block uses Helvetica, Arial and Verdana.
